note: Effects made with open-source web libraries, rendered on this machine by tools/web_capture.py (virtual clock, alpha) and placed in AE by MCP add_fx. Pages in tools/web_fx/, library versions and licenses in tools/web_fx/libs.json.

fx.name: confetti cannons
fx.use: Celebration burst: two cannons from the lower corners (bursts [{t, x, y, angle, spread, count}], shapes, scalar).

fx.name: particle fireworks
fx.use: Rockets and bursts over a dark scene (rate, gravity, speed).

fx.name: sparks
fx.use: A burst of glowing streaks from a point (x, y in %, or the target layer's centre): hits, impacts, a product landing.

fx.name: scribble
fx.use: Hand-drawn marker annotation around a layer: shape circle | underline | cross | arrow | box, drawn on like a pen, boiling on twos.

fx.name: flow field
fx.use: Calm generative background: thin lines drifting on a noise field (count, speed, bg for opaque).

fx.name: living gradient
fx.use: Living mesh gradient in four token colours with grain, loops cleanly every `loop` s.

fx.name: helix 3d
fx.use: The DNA helix in real 3D (spheres, soft light, a slow turn), or a glTF/GLB product on a turntable (model).

fx.name: drop 3d
fx.use: 3D physics: rounded cubes, spheres and pills in token colours rain down and pile up, with soft shadows (count, shapes, size, rate).
